title: Extraction and analysis of the VHP4Safety project board (Scrum@VHP4S)
description:
Extraction and analysis code and the exported board dataset underlying the supplementary information of Teunis et al. (2026), Promoting co-creation and flexibility: the agile approach of VHP4Safety.

The VHP4Safety consortium coordinated its development work on a shared GitHub Projects board ("Scrum@VHP4S"). This archive contains the GraphQL export script, the analysis scripts, the exported dataset (831 board items, snapshot of 19 July 2026) and all figures: monthly throughput, cumulative flow and open backlog, cycle time, Kaplan-Meier ticket lifetime, and distribution across repositories. Results are reported both for the full work set (776 issues and pull requests) and for the set excluding the 197 service-completeness items raised at the seventh project hackathon (579 items).

The project board is an internal consortium resource. The released dataset is therefore reduced to the seven fields required to reproduce the reported analyses: item type, state, repository, and the creation, closure, merge and last-updated timestamps. Every figure and summary statistic in the supplementary information reproduces from it unchanged.
